column17:
We rolled out Freshdesk in Switzerland, Germany, and Spain to serve both private and business customers. Spare parts and service requests are the dominating inquiries our customer service agents face today. Spare part inquiries follow a simple pattern. Customers provide a vague description of what they need, customer service asks for the product warranty number, customers sometimes misspell it, and after some back-and-forth, customers receive the spare part. We connected an in-house developed AI service to Freshdek. An AI agent now replies to customer inquiries, asks for the product warranty number, identifies the spare parts, and sends customers the direct link to the respective spare part item on our webshop. 
Service inquiries are similarly structured. Customers describe their problem, and the AI agent identifies the appropriate service package. Customers decide whether to purchase the service package, and AI runs all steps to qualify the service incident. Customer service then receives a pre-qualified ticket and only needs to call the customer to agree on a date and time for the service visit.
column18: We save 50% of the time spent on customer service interactions for both spare parts and service inquiries.

column17: I led a full experience transformation by standardizing quality, enforcing operational discipline, and institutionalizing data-driven decisions on top of Freshdesk’s feature set. The result is a scalable, repeatable support model that elevates customer and employee experience simultaneously - ultimately enabling and supporting the raped growth of our scale-up mode company.
column18:

column19: The project’s distinctiveness does not rely on inventing new methods but on extracting maximum operational leverage from standard Freshdesk capabilities in a high-complexity environment. The ticket load consists almost entirely of advanced troubleshooting cases that reach us only after customers exhaust a deep self-service ecosystem, yet a five-agent team handles roughly 75% of all volume, with two first-line agents closing more than a third on their own. This throughput is achievable only because the ticket-handling process has been rigorously engineered and fine-tuned within Freshdesk’s native features—automations, SLAs, structured inputs, analytics, and behavioral metrics. The uniqueness lies in applying an uncompromising, systems-driven operating model to complex technical tickets and proving that properly leveraged platform capabilities can deliver scale without headcount expansion.
